content.title: What Channel Is UConn Men's Basketball On? Live Stream, Start Time for Elite Eight Game vs. Duke | NESN
content.text: If you purchase a product or register for an account through one of the links on our site, we may receive compensation. Learn more > No. 2 UConn will face No. 1 Duke in a highly anticipated Elite Eight battle on Sunday.The Huskies defeated No. 3 Michigan State, 67-63, in a tight Sweet 16 contest to keep their championship dream alive. UConn will try to reach the Final Four for the third time in four seasons. Isaiah Evans and Cameron Boozer combined to score 47 of Duke's 80 points in a Sweet 16 victory over No. 5 St. John's. Caleb Foster added 11 points off the bench in his return from a foot injury, giving the Blue Devils a major boost during a deep tournament run.Here is everything you need to know about UConn vs. Duke, including TV and streaming options for the game.What channel is UConn vs. Duke on today?TV channel: CBSLive stream: Fubo, Paramount+UConn vs. Duke will air live on CBS. Fans can stream the game live on Fubo, which offers a free trial for new subscribers so you can try the service before you buy.Stream ESPN, ABC, CBS, Fox and 100-plus top channels of live TV and sports without cable.
